labels.text: Section 59(j)(1)(B): the dollar amount added to a child's earned income to cap the child's AMT exemption amount ("$5,000"; indexed for taxable years beginning after 1998 by section 59(j)(2), rounded to a multiple of $50). Only the unindexed statutory amount is pinned (taxable year 1998); indexed values are not, so any other year is MISSING_PARAMETER_VALUE. Section 55(d)(4)(A)(iii) turns section 59(j) off for taxable years beginning after 2017 (see the coverage rows of 26/59/j and 26/55/d/4 for the conflicting Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.12 reading).
section 59(j)(1)(B): "$5,000" (unindexed; the section 59(j)(2) adjustment starts after 1998)
